normalization: Input MinMax and output standardization, fitted only on the fitting partition at each stage.
window_rule: 5 consecutive valid source frames, increasing actual timestamps, no gap over max_gap.

function_approximation.selection: Single function with predeclared type/parameters; Train only
function_approximation.objective: Squared-error fitting plus spline roughness penalty; neural models retain MAE loss

distance_window5.input_correspondence: One distance per unit, oldest to current

distance_lstm_window5.input_correspondence: One distance feature at each step, oldest to current

distance_lstm_continuous.sequence_steps: From trial start to current frame
distance_lstm_continuous.input_correspondence: One distance feature at each step, oldest to current
distance_lstm_continuous.state_reset: Trial start or missing/gapped input; never reset at normal sliding-window boundaries

window_lstm_state: Zero state independently for each window; one distance feature per step.
lstm_state: Full trial from first valid frame to current frame; reset at trial boundary or invalid/gapped input.
lstm_training: Full-sequence backpropagation; batch_size counts trials; padded target positions masked; each trial has equal total loss weight.
lstm_comparison: Main comparison uses the same eligible MLP target frames; full LSTM trajectories and metrics also exported separately.
